key: SIMON: I want to forget about everything...
en: SIMON: I want to forget about everything...
ja: サイモン: すべてを忘れてしまいたい……

key: Except Tara.
en: Except Tara.
ja: タラのことを除いては。

key: Of course, I have nothing to remember her by. Not even her full name.
en: Of course, I have nothing to remember her by. Not even her full name.
ja: もちろん、彼女を思い出す手がかりなんて何もない。フルネームすら。

key: All of who she was is now left at the bottom of the Tanzan Lake.
en: All of who she was is now left at the bottom of the Tanzan Lake.
ja: 彼女という存在のすべてが、今はタンザン湖の底に沈んでいる。

key: That can't be...
en: That can't be...
ja: そんなはずは……

key: You actually were able to retrieve her ID tag?
en: You actually were able to retrieve her ID tag?
ja: 本当に彼女のIDタグを見つけ出したのか?

key: Please, let me see it.
en: Please, let me see it.
ja: 頼む、見せてくれ。

key: \PN handed over the ID tag.
en: \PN handed over the ID tag.
ja: \PNはIDタグを渡した。

key: ..."Tara Copperman."
en: ..."Tara Copperman."
ja: ……「タラ・コッパーマン」。

key: That's--
en: That's--
ja: それは――

key: That's my last name.
en: That's my last name.
ja: オレの苗字だ。

key: I have much to reconsider.
en: I have much to reconsider.
ja: 考え直すべきことが、山ほどある。

key: \PN, thank you for being as good of a friend to me as you were an adversary.
en: \PN, thank you for being as good of a friend to me as you were an adversary.
ja: \PN、敵として立ち向かってくれたのと同じくらい、友として接してくれたこと、感謝する。

key: I'm sure it wasn't easy to get this, especially considering the circumstances, so please have this TM in return.
en: I'm sure it wasn't easy to get this, especially considering the circumstances, so please have this TM in return.
ja: 状況を考えると、これを手に入れるのは簡単ではなかったはずだ。お礼に、このわざマシンを受け取ってくれ。

key: It was being passed around the other Meteors around the time I left, but you'll get more use out of it now, I imagine.
en: It was being passed around the other Meteors around the time I left, but you'll get more use out of it now, I imagine.
ja: オレが抜ける頃、他のメテオの連中の間で回されてたものだが、今はお前が使う方が役に立つだろう。

key: SIMON: Now, if it's all the same to you,
en: SIMON: Now, if it's all the same to you,
ja: サイモン: それじゃ、よければ、

key: I'm going to go think about my life choices.
en: I'm going to go think about my life choices.
ja: オレは自分の人生の選択について、少し考えることにする。

key: Good day.
en: Good day.
ja: ではな。

key: SIMON: So you found me, \PN.
en: SIMON: So you found me, \PN.
ja: サイモン: 見つけたか、\PN。

key: I've cut my ties with Meteor. But out of respect to my former comrades, I dare not betray any of their secrets. Sorry.
en: I've cut my ties with Meteor. But out of respect to my former comrades, I dare not betray any of their secrets. Sorry.
ja: メテオとの縁は切った。だが、かつての仲間への敬意から、あえて秘密を裏切ることはしない。悪いな。

key: Let's just pretend like I was never involved with that in the first place.
en: Let's just pretend like I was never involved with that in the first place.
ja: そもそも、オレがあれに関わってなかったことにしてくれ。

key: I want to forget about all of them.
en: I want to forget about all of them.
ja: あいつら全員のことを忘れたいんだ。

key: I used to go on a walk through the Malchous Forest every morning.
en: I used to go on a walk through the Malchous Forest every morning.
ja: 昔は毎朝、マルコウの森を散歩してたんだ。

key: But now that the Jasper Ward has been closed off, there's nowhere for me to go...
en: But now that the Jasper Ward has been closed off, there's nowhere for me to go...
ja: でも今はジャスパーワードが封鎖されてて、行き場がなくて……

key: It's so nice to be able to get back into my old routine.
en: It's so nice to be able to get back into my old routine.
ja: 昔の日課に戻れるのは、本当にいいものだ。

key: But as much as I used to stroll around Jasper, the stairs aren't for me.
en: But as much as I used to stroll around Jasper, the stairs aren't for me.
ja: でも、昔はジャスパーをよく歩き回ったものだが、階段はどうも性に合わない。

key: Now I have a beautiful lakeside instead.
en: Now I have a beautiful lakeside instead.
ja: 今は代わりに、美しい湖畔がある。

key: The gangs around here have been more violent lately...
en: The gangs around here have been more violent lately...
ja: この辺りのギャング、最近前より荒っぽくなってて……

key: Is something happening?
en: Is something happening?
ja: 何かあったのかしら?

key: I used to be afraid of those gangster types, but after working with them on repairs, I'm totally not!
en: I used to be afraid of those gangster types, but after working with them on repairs, I'm totally not!
ja: 昔はああいうギャングっぽい奴らが怖かったけど、修復作業を一緒にやってから、全然平気になったよ!

key: Those guys work hard when they put their minds to it, you know?
en: Those guys work hard when they put their minds to it, you know?
ja: ああいう奴らも、その気になれば結構真面目に働くもんだね。
